test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following units is considered as the foundation of the Panchayat Raj System to perform functions and powers entrusted to it by the State Legislatures?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gram Sabha**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Gram Sabha** is the foundation of the Panchayati Raj System in India.
 
• The 73rd Amendment envisages the Gram Sabha as the foundation of the Panchayat Raj System to perform functions and powers entrusted to it by the State Legislatures.
 
• The **amendment provides for a three-tier Panchayat Raj System at the village, intermediate and district levels.**
 
• Articles 243A provides that the Gram Sabha may exercise such power and perform such functions at the village level as the Legislature of a State may by law provide.
 
• The 73rd amendment thus envisages the Gram Sabha as the foundation of the Panchayat Raj System.
 
• “Gram Sabha” means a body consisting of persons registered in the electoral rolls comprised within the area of Panchayat at the village level.
 
• In the Panchayat Raj System Gram Sabha is the only permanent unit.
 
• Duration of Panchayat i.e. Mukhiyas and other members of Panchayat continue for 5 years only from the date appointed for the first meeting, but the villagers do not change. 

Thus, the **73rd amendment act is the constitutional amendment act on Panchayat Raj Institutions.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Panchayat Samiti**

 
 
• An intermediate level institution in the Panchayati Raj system 
 
• Also known as a block panchayat, taluka panchayat, or mandal 
 
• The chief executive officer of a Panchayat Samiti is the Block Development Officer 
 
 
 
• **Zila Parishad **
 
 
• A district-level institution in the Panchayati Raj system
 
• Also known as the District Council or District Panchayat
 
• The District Collector heads the Zila Parishad
 
 
 
• **Nagarpalika**
 
 
• **​**Administers smaller urban areas
 
• Interacts with the state government
 
• Responsible for duties and responsibilities such as urban planning, water supply, and public health​
